# PRD v5 fixtures — released v0.5.0 record formats

These files were produced by the **released v0.5.0 kit** (git tag `v0.5.0`, commit
`2d244eb4197638f4f9344912baacc2e2cff3a770`, `template/scripts/` of that commit) on a
throwaway project on 2026-09-11, before any PRD v5 runtime code existed. They are the
old-format inputs that migration (T-58), historical-evidence handling (T-55) and the
contract tests (T-47) run against; they are never regenerated by the new runtime.

Steps run with the pinned kit (`bash scripts/pincer-ticket.sh` / `node
scripts/pincer-runtime.cjs` of v0.5.0), in order:

1. `git init`; commit `.gitignore` (`.pincer/`) and `base.txt`.
2. Commit `.prd/prd-v1.md` (`ticketed`), `tickets/T-01-example.md` (check
   `test "$(cat value.txt)" = good`), `tickets/T-02-example.md` (`true`, depends on T-01)
   and `value.txt`.
3. Legacy phase: `verify T-01`, `done T-01` → receipts in the ticket (`legacy/tickets/`
   is the copy taken here; `T-02` is still open).
4. `migrate --preview --prd .prd/prd-v1.md` (`outputs/migrate-preview.txt`), then
   `migrate --apply … --authorization "user approved the breakdown in the planning
   session on 2026-09-05"` (`outputs/migrate-apply.txt`) → `changes/prd-v1.json`
   (schema 1 binding with `legacy_receipts`), `backups/<ts>/tickets/T-01-example.md`.
5. `verify T-01` (attempt 1), `start`/`verify`/`done T-02` (attempt 2); PRD set to
   `built`; committed as the candidate `e8e55a7fdd4f359eff1cb3b9ba143edfe96af861`
   (base `5d3ec528a1baac4a1bb095069f94aad18a06cb4d`).
6. `check C-01 --candidate <candidate> -- test "$(cat value.txt)" = good` (attempt 3),
   `evidence export` from a draft → `evidence/prd-v1/<candidate>/` (schema 2), `NOTES.md`.
7. `pincer-status.sh` and `status --json` → `outputs/status.txt`, `outputs/status.json`.

Layout (paths are relative to the fixture project root; leading dots dropped so the
fixture's own `.gitignore` does not hide the runtime state from this repository):

| Fixture path | Project path |
| --- | --- |
| `v0.5.0/changes/prd-v1.json` | `.prd/changes/prd-v1.json` |
| `v0.5.0/prd/prd-v1.md` | `.prd/prd-v1.md` |
| `v0.5.0/evidence/…` | `.prd/evidence/…` |
| `v0.5.0/runtime/…` | `.pincer/runtime/…` (`lock/` and `journal/` omitted: empty) |
| `v0.5.0/backups/…` | `.pincer/backups/…` |
| `v0.5.0/tickets/…`, `NOTES.md` | same |
| `v0.5.0/gitignore` | `.gitignore` |
| `legacy/tickets/…` | `tickets/…` of the pre-migration project |

Edits after generation, for privacy only: the recording host name in the attempt
records was replaced by `fixture-host.example`, and the absolute project root in
`outputs/status.*` by `/fixture`. Nothing else was changed.
